notes.title: Update 1.40 +Hotfix1
notes.notes:
In addition to fixing issues that have accumulated over the past half a year, I'm pleased to introduce New Cliffs, new defense options, and some balance changes!
It could be DLC, but why not make it a regular update?

Turrets can now be modified for an additional fee:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32562111/30b2b3b2d8551fceecec21657efa7936321b7ef9.png[/img]
New cliffs can be a challenge for logistics:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32562111/032819dcd0a867e20d165a92607f294c84828d76.png[/img]
I am also pleased to present our next game in the Cliff Empire universe: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478970/AI_Olympius/]AI Olympius[/url]. Over the past year in early access, we've managed to polish it up quite a bit, the story has also progressed to 80% done, and the game also has a building feature, not as large as here, but it's quite interesting. 
So for at least the next six months, it will be in an intensive development phase, so join us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32562111/5395e538d89b5a43ce4468be949e4ce4a120d2a8.png[/img]
I hope I didn't break anything in the current update, so if something doesn't work as expected, write to me and I'll fix it as soon as possible!
[list]
[*]Three new Cliffs have been added.
[*]Defensive turrets now have upgrade options: interceptor, range, shield.
[*]The smallest enemy ships now have less HP.
[*]The capacity of goods for a trade bridge has been increased from 10 to 15, now the trade turnover of 2 bridges can replace 3 bridges.
[*]The 3D printing factory, after being upgraded, now uses 1 material (was 2) to produce 6 units of goods.
[*]New localization: Thai.
[*]Changes have been made to the Czech and Turkish localizations.
[*]The game is built on a newer version of Unity.
[*]Fixed a bug where upgrading Zeppelins from the University did not work properly.
[*]Adjusted the capsule charging acceleration rate at the lower level to reflect the improvement in charging speed.
[*]The learning period defense mechanism no longer adds matter to the Cold Storage or Mall.
[*]Orbital debris no longer destroys lower-level buildings when dropped, it was fun but caused unnecessary problems.
[*]Fixed display of people sitting in the air when starting to build roads.
[*]Fixed a bug where after the cutscene the camera returned to orbit with a light background with clouds.
[*]Fixed a bug in which the effect of weather conditions did not end if the player was on an orbital station.
[*]Fixed a problem with shadows on the colonnade.
[*]Fixed problems with the rain sound.
[*]Small optimization, minor UI fixes.
[/list]
All changes are made in both the remastered version and the version with the old graphics.
The Mac version will be delayed, it's quite a time-consuming process, and it will start when I'm sure everything works properly after the latest changes.

[*]For the remastered version, the option to disable the Bloom effect has been added to the settings.
[*]Buildings from Workshop are no longer labeled as "under construction" after completion.
[*]The sound of a building being destroyed is now slightly quieter.

[*]The time acceleration button has been scaled up.

notes.title: Update 1.33
notes.notes:
Something has changed in the integration of Steam in the Reamster version, hopefully nothing will break. Some inner work to better support Workshop.

The update included a lot of balance changes, especially early access to the Engineering Bureau should be affected game a lot. The difficulty of the main storyline has also been slightly decreased, and there are also many changes in the simulation mode.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*]Engineering Bureau is now available from the start, but some of its researches are unlocked with the Orbital Station, the other part with the Ice Citadel.
[*]Marauder attacks no longer appear above the city that was on the way to the target.
[*]The birth rate has been increased by 37%
[*]In the construction menu, you can now see exactly how many of each type of building there are in the city, and you can also highlight them to make it easier to search for them in the city.
[*]The conditions of the first task to settle people from orbit have been changed: settle 2800 → 2300 people
[*]Prestige task conditions changed, target prestige requirement reduced from 120 to 100
[*]IceCitadel settlement task conditions reduced from 1500 to 1200
[*]Task conditions for settlement of 6000 people, target prestige requirement reduced from 120 to 100
[*]Increased drone limits on Ice Citadel and White Plains.
[*]The number of workers on solar panels in orbit has been reduced from 20 to 5
[*]The number of workers on the wind generator field has been reduced from 4 to 2.
[*]The number of battery station workers (regular and wall-mounted) has been reduced from 7 to 4.
[*]Now no workers are needed to maintain the small vertical solar panel.
[*]Time acceleration speed changed, step was 3x → 6x now 4x → 8x.
[*]Effectiveness of Eco Pillars increased +5 → +7 global ecology.
[*]The amount of theft is reduced, in orbit the tendency to steal is also reduced even more.
[*]In "Defense" mode, the reward for destroying stingrays has been increased from 90 to 120.
[*]In "Defense" mode, the first wave of enemies comes later, and the interval between waves is slightly increased.
[*]It is now impossible to sell all cargo drones to other cliffs to avoid a dead end.
[*]Fixed a bug where lower-level construction would be blocked around a dual cliff, even though the space should be available.
[*]Fixed small errors in Ukrainian and Italian localizations.
[*]The size of the interface can be increased even more. (for 4k monitors)
[*]The Esc key now exits tourist mode, also added a hint when entering tourist mode - how to exit it.
[*]Fixed a bug where the camera, when switching between cliffs, moved to a certain structure, and not to the center of the cliff.
[*]Minor UI improvements.
[/list]

White Plains:
[list]
[*] Lower-level structures can now be built here.
[*] Raised platform has been added to the Workshop, which will work well at this location, I tested how the new Steam integration works on it.
[*]Fixed a bug where the flashlight did not shine on the surface, but only on buildings.
[/list]

Only in the remastered version:
[list]
[*]Drones disappear more smoothly at long range.
[/list]

Another Hotfix (1.33f1):
[list]
[*]Eco Tower efficiency tuned.
[*]Efficiency of small vertical solar panels reduced from +8 to +6.
[*]Enemies no longer attack wall wind generators (avoiding the problem of rebuilding them and what was on them.)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.32
notes.notes:
The long-awaited Portuguese localization has finally been added to the game, being busy with a new project did not even give me a free day to do it.

In the coming month, I plan to return to Cliff Empire a bit and make some improvements based on the player's feedback.
Also, if you have any feedback about anything that annoys you in the game, please write it in the comments below. I will do my best to fix everything that is within my power.

Also, note that access to the Workshop has been opened. It has been available for a long time, but I didn't know that there was such a button as "make visible to everybody" so that it became fully visible.

The launch parameters of the remastered version have changed a bit, so if you had a shortcut to CliffEmpire_HQ.exe it will no longer work, you need to create a new one.

This time the update is not in beta. Also it brings a new building, new functionality and changes to balance.
[list]
[*] The speed of first row researches is increased. Implemented to make the start of the game more dynamic.
[*] After a full study of any category (15 out of 15 studies studied) - in the research window, continuous improvement of industries of your choice becomes available. To make the impact of universities more significant in the later stages of the game.
[*] The new building, the AI ​​Dataсenter, in the "Business" section, is designed to increase the efficiency of universities and continuous improvements at a later stage of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32562111/f63508398124e125fd851c8e9dcf29c828453753.png[/img]
[*] Added a special interface for understanding demand and pricing. The mechanics always worked, but did not have a proper indication. Understanding supply and demand allows you to more effectively build trading and production between cities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32562111/664be1f1f390ad136bf8fd6046c4916af2f1dd7e.png[/img]
[*] Increased minimum price of goods by 1.
[*] New texts added to localization document. Temporary machine translation, I hope for your help with corrections.
[*] Refreshed loading window.
[/list]

The development of the tactical shooter AI Olympius, which will tell the further history of the Cliff Empire universe after the return of humans to earth, is also underway.
